clab_yaml:
name: digital-twin
mgmt:
  network: clab-acme
  ipv4-subnet: 192.168.100.0/24
topology:
  nodes:
    cold-archive:
      kind: linux
      stages:
        create:
          wait-for:
          - node: mon-collector
            stage: healthy
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/state/digital-twin/cold-archive:/var/lib/cold-archive
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      env:
        DA_S3_ADDR: :8080
        DA_MGMT_ADDR: :8081
        DA_S3_TLS_CERT: /certs/server.pem
        DA_S3_TLS_KEY: /certs/server-key.pem
        DA_ACCESS_KEY_ID: dummy
        DA_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: dummy
        DA_ARCHIVE-CTL_URL: http://192.168.100.20:8090
        DA_STATE_DIR: /var/lib/cold-archive
        DA_CATALOG_MISMATCH: discard
        DA_MIGRATION_QUEUE_SEC: '0.2'
        DA_MIGRATION_WRITE_SEC: '0.3'
        DA_RESTORE_DELAY_SEC: '1'
        DA_SYSLOG_TARGETS: 192.168.100.85:514
      image: archive-sim/cold-archive:latest
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.10
    archive-ctl:
      kind: linux
      stages:
        create:
          wait-for:
          - node: mon-collector
            stage: healthy
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/state/digital-twin/archive-ctl:/var/lib/archive-ctl
      env:
        DB_ADDR: :8090
        DB_SYSLOG_TARGETS: 192.168.100.85:514:error+warning+information
        DB_SNMP_COMMUNITY: <redacted>
        DB_SNMP_TRAP_TARGETS: 192.168.100.85:162:error+warning+information
      image: archive-sim/archive-ctl:latest
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.20
    s3client:
      kind: linux
      entrypoint: sleep
      cmd: infinity
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/ca.pem:/certs/ca.pem:ro
      env:
        AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: dummy
        AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: dummy
        AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
        AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3: https://192.168.100.10:8080
        AWS_CA_BUNDLE: /certs/ca.pem
      image: acme/aws-cli:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.30
    hot:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/hot/hot-tls.Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
      cmd: caddy run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
      image: acme/hot-tls:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.40
    hot-store:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/components/hot-s3.identities.json:/s3.json:ro
      cmd: server -s3 -s3.port=8333 -s3.config=/s3.json -dir=/data -ip=192.168.100.41
        -volume.max=1000 -master.volumeSizeLimitMB=64
      image: acme/hot-s3:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.41
    server1:
      kind: linux
      devices:
      - /dev/kvm
      - /dev/net/tun
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/vm/digital-twin/server1:/vm
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/guest:/guest:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      env:
        IPMI_USER: admin
        IPMI_PASS: password
        REDFISH_PORT: '443'
        IPMI_PORT: '623'
        TLS_CERT: /certs/server.pem
        TLS_KEY: /certs/server-key.pem
        VM_MEMORY: '512'
        VM_CPUS: '1'
        VM_BOOT_MODE: bios
        VM_MANUFACTURER: Acme-Twin
        VM_MODEL: TWIN-Q35
        VM_SERIAL_NUMBER: TWIN-SRV-0001
        FAULT_API_ADDR: 192.168.100.50:8623
        FAULT_API_TOKEN: <redacted>
        VM_DISK_SIZE: 1G
        QEMU_EXTRA_ARGS: -kernel /guest/vmlinuz -initrd /guest/initrd.img -append
          console=ttyS0
      image: acme/qemu-bmc:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.50
    server2:
      kind: linux
      devices:
      - /dev/kvm
      - /dev/net/tun
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/vm/digital-twin/server2:/vm
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/guest:/guest:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      env:
        IPMI_USER: admin
        IPMI_PASS: password
        REDFISH_PORT: '443'
        IPMI_PORT: '623'
        TLS_CERT: /certs/server.pem
        TLS_KEY: /certs/server-key.pem
        VM_MEMORY: '512'
        VM_CPUS: '1'
        VM_BOOT_MODE: bios
        VM_MANUFACTURER: Acme-Twin
        VM_MODEL: TWIN-Q35
        VM_SERIAL_NUMBER: TWIN-SRV-0002
        FAULT_API_ADDR: 192.168.100.51:8623
        FAULT_API_TOKEN: <redacted>
        VM_DISK_SIZE: 1G
        QEMU_EXTRA_ARGS: -kernel /guest/vmlinuz -initrd /guest/initrd.img -append
          console=ttyS0
      image: acme/qemu-bmc:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.51
    bmc-client:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/ca.pem:/certs/ca.pem:ro
      image: acme/bmc-client:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.35
      exec:
      - ip link set eth1 up
      - ip addr add 10.200.0.250/24 dev eth1
      - ip route replace 10.200.1.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.2.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.3.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.10.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.20.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.30.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.40.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.50.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.60.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.90.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
    objgw:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/objgw/objgw-tls.Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
      cmd: caddy run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
      image: acme/objgw-tls:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.60
    objgw-core:
      kind: linux
      stages:
        create:
          wait-for:
          - node: objgw-db
            stage: healthy
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/ca.pem:/certs/ca.pem:ro
      env:
        OBJGW_CORE_ADDR: :8443
        OBJGW_ADMIN_ADDR: 0.0.0.0:8444
        OBJGW_ADMIN_TOKEN: <redacted>
        OBJGW_CREDENTIAL_KEY: <redacted>
        OBJGW_DATABASE_WAIT: 2m
        OBJGW_DATABASE_URL: postgres://objgw:<redacted>@192.168.100.62:5432/objgw?sslmode=disable
        OBJGW_TRUSTED_PROXIES: 192.168.100.60/32
        OBJGW_LOG_FORMAT: json
        SSL_CERT_FILE: /certs/ca.pem
        OBJGW_HOTSTORE_ENDPOINT: https://192.168.100.40:443
        OBJGW_HOTSTORE_ACCESS_KEY: hotkey
        OBJGW_HOTSTORE_SECRET_KEY: hotsecret
        OBJGW_HOTSTORE_INSECURE_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY: 'false'
        OBJGW_COLD-ARCHIVE_ENDPOINT: https://192.168.100.10:8080
        OBJGW_COLD-ARCHIVE_ACCESS_KEY: dummy
        OBJGW_COLD-ARCHIVE_SECRET_KEY: dummy
        OBJGW_COLD-ARCHIVE_INSECURE_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY: 'false'
        OBJGW_COLD-ARCHIVE_STORAGE_CLASS: DEEP_ARCHIVE
        OBJGW_TAPE_CONFIRM_INTERVAL: 2s
        OBJGW_RECALL_INTERVAL: 1s
        OBJGW_RECONCILE_INTERVAL: 30s
        OBJGW_LIFECYCLE_INTERVAL: 30s
        OBJGW_TAPE_STALL_THRESHOLD: 2m
        OBJGW_TAPE_RETRY_AFTER: 10m
        OBJGW_MAX_RETENTION: 1h
      image: acme/objgw-core:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.61
    objgw-db:
      kind: linux
      env:
        POSTGRES_PASSWORD: <redacted>
        POSTGRES_DB: objgw
      healthcheck:
        test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U objgw -d objgw
        start-period: 2
        interval: 1
        timeout: 3
        retries: 60
      image: acme/objgw-db:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.62
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/objgw-db/objgw-db.init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-objgw-role.sql:ro
    tape-fab:
      kind: linux
      image: fc-switch-sim/fcsw:dev
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.70
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/tape-fab/fc-tape-fab.switch.yaml:/etc/fcsw/switch.yaml:ro
    tape-srv:
      kind: linux
      devices:
      - /dev/kvm
      - /dev/net/tun
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/vm/digital-twin/tape-srv:/vm
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/components/fc-switch-sim/.cache:/home/user/acme-infra/.cache/components/fc-switch-sim/.cache:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      env:
        VM_MEMORY: '4096'
        VM_CPUS: '2'
        VM_BOOT_MODE: bios
        VM_CDROM: /vm/seed.iso
        VM_NETWORKS: eth1
        VM_NET_MTU: '9500'
        VM_MACS: 52:54:00:fc:71:01
        POWER_ON_AT_START: 'true'
        IPMI_USER: admin
        IPMI_PASS: password
        TLS_CERT: /certs/server.pem
        TLS_KEY: /certs/server-key.pem
        QEMU_EXTRA_ARGS: -nic user,model=virtio-net-pci,mac=52:54:00:aa:00:01,hostfwd=tcp::22-:22,hostfwd=tcp::9190-:9190
      image: acme/qemu-bmc:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.71
    tape-lib:
      kind: linux
      devices:
      - /dev/kvm
      - /dev/net/tun
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/vm/digital-twin/tape-lib:/vm
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/components/fc-switch-sim/.cache:/home/user/acme-infra/.cache/components/fc-switch-sim/.cache:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      env:
        VM_MEMORY: '4096'
        VM_CPUS: '2'
        VM_BOOT_MODE: bios
        VM_CDROM: /vm/seed.iso
        VM_NETWORKS: eth1
        VM_NET_MTU: '9500'
        VM_MACS: 52:54:00:fc:72:01
        POWER_ON_AT_START: 'true'
        IPMI_USER: admin
        IPMI_PASS: password
        TLS_CERT: /certs/server.pem
        TLS_KEY: /certs/server-key.pem
        QEMU_EXTRA_ARGS: -nic user,model=virtio-net-pci,mac=52:54:00:aa:00:01,hostfwd=tcp::22-:22,hostfwd=tcp::8080-:8080,hostfwd=udp::161-:161
      image: acme/qemu-bmc:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.72
    mgmt-sw:
      kind: linux
      image: acme/mgmt-sw:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.80
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mgmt-sw/mgmt-sw.ports.conf:/etc/mgmt-sw/ports.conf:ro
    stage0:
      kind: linux
      cmd: sleep infinity
      image: acme/mgmt-sw:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.81
      exec:
      - ip link set eth1 up
      - ip addr add 10.200.0.5/24 dev eth1
      - ip route replace 10.200.1.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.2.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.3.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.10.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.20.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.30.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.40.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.50.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.60.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
      - ip route replace 10.200.90.0/24 via 10.200.0.1
    pve:
      kind: linux
      devices:
      - /dev/kvm
      - /dev/net/tun
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/vm/digital-twin/pve:/vm
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/images/proxmox:/home/user/acme-infra/.cache/images/proxmox:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/server-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      env:
        IPMI_USER: admin
        IPMI_PASS: password
        REDFISH_PORT: '443'
        IPMI_PORT: '623'
        TLS_CERT: /certs/server.pem
        TLS_KEY: /certs/server-key.pem
        VM_MEMORY: '8192'
        VM_CPUS: '4'
        VM_BOOT_MODE: bios
        VM_NETWORKS: eth1
        VM_MACS: '52:54:00:30:00:11'
        POWER_ON_AT_START: 'true'
      image: acme/qemu-bmc:pinned
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.55
    fw1:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/secrets/digital-twin/hostkeys/fw1_ed25519:/seed/hostkey:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw1/role.fw:/etc/acme-node/role:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw1/net.conf:/etc/acme-node/net.conf:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw1/keepalived.conf:/etc/acme-node/keepalived.conf:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw1/base.nft:/etc/acme-node/base.nft:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw1/authorized_keys:/etc/acme-node/authorized_keys:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw1/sudoers.fw:/etc/acme-node/sudoers:ro
      image: acme/infra-node:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.82
    fw2:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/secrets/digital-twin/hostkeys/fw2_ed25519:/seed/hostkey:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw2/role.fw:/etc/acme-node/role:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw2/net.conf:/etc/acme-node/net.conf:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw2/keepalived.conf:/etc/acme-node/keepalived.conf:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw2/base.nft:/etc/acme-node/base.nft:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw2/authorized_keys:/etc/acme-node/authorized_keys:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/fw2/sudoers.fw:/etc/acme-node/sudoers:ro
      image: acme/infra-node:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.83
    dns:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/secrets/digital-twin/hostkeys/dns_ed25519:/seed/hostkey:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/dns/role.dns:/etc/acme-node/role:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/dns/net.conf:/etc/acme-node/net.conf:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/dns/zone.head:/etc/acme-node/zone.head:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/dns/authorized_keys:/etc/acme-node/authorized_keys:ro
      image: acme/infra-node:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.84
    mon-collector:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/secrets/digital-twin/hostkeys/mon-collector_ed25519:/seed/hostkey:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/ca.pem:/certs/ca.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/mon-collector.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/mon-collector-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/secrets/digital-twin/sakutei_metrics_token:/seed/secrets/sakutei_metrics_token:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/secrets/digital-twin/db_snmp_community:/seed/snmp_community:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-collector/role.mon:/etc/acme-node/role:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-collector/net.conf:/etc/acme-node/net.conf:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-collector/mon.vars:/etc/acme-node/mon.vars:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-collector/authorized_keys:/etc/acme-node/authorized_keys:ro
      healthcheck:
        test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - test -f /run/acme-node.ready && pgrep -x acme-rsyslogd >/dev/null
        start-period: 2
        interval: 1
        timeout: 3
      image: acme/infra-node:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.85
    mon-db:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/secrets/digital-twin/hostkeys/mon-db_ed25519:/seed/hostkey:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/ca.pem:/certs/ca.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/mon-db.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/mon-db-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-db/role.mon:/etc/acme-node/role:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-db/net.conf:/etc/acme-node/net.conf:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-db/mon.vars:/etc/acme-node/mon.vars:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-db/authorized_keys:/etc/acme-node/authorized_keys:ro
      image: acme/infra-node:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.86
    mon-alert:
      kind: linux
      binds:
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/secrets/digital-twin/hostkeys/mon-alert_ed25519:/seed/hostkey:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/ca.pem:/certs/ca.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/mon-alert.pem:/certs/server.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/environments/digital-twin/certs/mon-alert-key.pem:/certs/server-key.pem:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-alert/role.mon:/etc/acme-node/role:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-alert/net.conf:/etc/acme-node/net.conf:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-alert/mon.vars:/etc/acme-node/mon.vars:ro
      - /home/user/acme-infra/.cache/rendered/digital-twin/mon-alert/authorized_keys:/etc/acme-node/authorized_keys:ro
      image: acme/infra-node:local
      mgmt-ipv4: 192.168.100.87
  links:
  - endpoints:
    - tape-srv:eth1
    - tape-fab:eth1
    mtu: 9500
  - endpoints:
    - tape-lib:eth1
    - tape-fab:eth2
    mtu: 9500
  - endpoints:
    - mgmt-sw:eth2
    - pve:eth1
  - endpoints:
    - mgmt-sw:eth3
    - fw1:eth1
  - endpoints:
    - mgmt-sw:eth4
    - fw2:eth1
  - endpoints:
    - mgmt-sw:eth5
    - dns:eth1
  - endpoints:
    - mgmt-sw:eth6
    - mon-collector:eth1
  - endpoints:
    - mgmt-sw:eth7
    - mon-db:eth1
  - endpoints:
    - mgmt-sw:eth8
    - mon-alert:eth1
  - endpoints:
    - mgmt-sw:eth24
    - bmc-client:eth1
  - endpoints:
    - mgmt-sw:eth23
    - stage0:eth1
